registered_risks.title: Password spraying through VPN-02
registered_risks.description: An attacker trying common passwords across many accounts could exploit single-factor sign-in for standard users on VPN-02 (vpn gateway), affecting IT Operations services.
registered_risks.threat: An attacker trying common passwords across many accounts

registered_risks.title: Unauthorized network scanning of VPN-02
registered_risks.description: An attacker mapping open services could exploit unfiltered internal network paths on VPN-02 (vpn gateway), affecting IT Operations services.

registered_risks.title: Denial of service against VPN-02
registered_risks.description: A volumetric or application-layer flood could exploit limited upstream filtering on VPN-02 (vpn gateway), affecting IT Operations services.

registered_risks.title: Unpatched critical vulnerabilities on VPN-02
registered_risks.description: An attacker exploiting a known vulnerability could exploit missing security patches on VPN-02 (vpn gateway), affecting IT Operations services.
registered_risks.threat: An attacker exploiting a known vulnerability

registered_risks.title: Insufficient security logging on VPN-02
registered_risks.description: An intrusion going unnoticed could exploit incomplete log forwarding on VPN-02 (vpn gateway), affecting IT Operations services.
